hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve Uniswap v4 hook that replaces the standard AMM with a configurable reserve curve backed by Euler vaults. Swaps are executed by taking input tokens into an Euler vault and withdrawing output tokens from another Euler vault via the EVC, with a curve invariant verified on each swap. Liquidity provisioning via standard Uniswap v4 positions is blocked.
